name: CSS Grid Playground
summary: Tune grid columns, rows, gaps, and alignment with a live preview and copy-ready CSS.
description: Interactive CSS Grid playground: set columns and rows, choose fr/px/auto tracks, adjust gaps, and control justify/align for items and content. Preview cells live and copy a .grid-container rule. Runs entirely in your browser.

faqs.question: What does fr vs px vs auto mean?
faqs.answer: fr shares free space equally, px uses a fixed pixel track size, and auto sizes tracks to their content.

faqs.question: When do justify-content and align-content matter?
faqs.answer: They distribute extra space in the grid container when tracks do not fill the full area (often with px/auto tracks).

faqs.question: Is anything uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. The playground runs entirely in your browser.
